/* Tbm04Mapper.selectHistorySessionList */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.TITLE AS title , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(A.OPENED_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(A.STARTED_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(A.ENDED_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(A.INSERT_DATE, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate /* 연계 위험성평가 수 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount /* 출결 집계. 참석=실입실(ENTRY_AT NOT NULL) 기준, 미이수=입실했으나 미완료(NULL or NOT_COMPLETED). prafta-app-031: 자동이수 폐지로 종료 세션에 COMPLETION_STATUS_CD=NULL(미완료 입실자)이 상시 잔존하므로 앱(selectAdminHistoryStat)과 동일 정의로 통일(참석=이수+미이수 항등식 보장). */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 참석자 회사 조건 제거 — 타사(지정 체인) 참석자를 개설사 집계에 포함한다. 인가 전제: 바깥 historyWhere 가 A.CMPNY_CD = gvCmpnyCd(세션 소유)로 이미 제한한다. */ WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL ) AS attendanceCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 참석자 회사 조건 제거 — 타사(지정 체인) 참석자를 개설사 집계에 포함한다. 인가 전제: 바깥 historyWhere 가 A.CMPNY_CD = gvCmpnyCd(세션 소유)로 이미 제한한다. */ WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completedCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 참석자 회사 조건 제거 — 타사(지정 체인) 참석자를 개설사 집계에 포함한다. 인가 전제: 바깥 historyWhere 가 A.CMPNY_CD = gvCmpnyCd(세션 소유)로 이미 제한한다. */ WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND (AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD IS NULL OR AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED') ) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
/* 종료일(없으면 등록일) 최신순 */ ORDER BY IFNULL(A.ENDED_AT, A.INSERT_DATE) DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectAttendanceEvents */ SELECT EV.EVENT_NO AS eventNo , EV.EVENT_TYPE_CD AS eventTypeCd , ET.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS eventTypeNm , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(EV.EVENT_TIME, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS eventTime , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(EV.SERVER_RECEIVED_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS serverReceivedAt , EV.EVENT_DATA AS eventData FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE_EVENT EV LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS054' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) ET ON ( EV.EVENT_TYPE_CD = ET.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
WHERE EV.ATTENDANCE_CD = #{attendanceCd} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( S.SESSION_CD = AT.SESSION_CD ) WHERE AT.ATTENDANCE_CD = #{attendanceCd} AND EV.CMPNY_CD = AT.CMPNY_CD AND S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) ORDER BY EV.EVENT_TIME, EV.EVENT_NO LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectAttendanceSignInfo */ SELECT AT.ATTENDANCE_CD AS attendanceCd , AT.CMPNY_CD AS attendeeCmpnyCd , S.SITE_CD AS sessionSiteCd , AT.ENTRY_SIGN_FILE_MGMT_CD AS entrySignFileMgmtCd , AT.EXIT_SIGN_FILE_MGMT_CD AS exitSignFileMgmtCd FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) WHERE AT.ATTENDANCE_CD = #{attendanceCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectAttendanceGuard */ SELECT AT.ATTENDANCE_CD AS attendanceCd , AT.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 타사 참석자도 개설사가 미이수 처리할 수 있어야 한다. 출결행의 회사 조건 대신, 세션이 내 회사(개설사) 소유임을 조인 조건으로 SQL 안에서 강제한다. */ INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) WHERE AT.ATTENDANCE_CD = #{attendanceCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectUserAttendances */ SELECT AT.ATTENDANCE_CD AS attendanceCd , AT.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS sessionTitle , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, S.INSERT_DATE), @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS sessionDate , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(AT.ENTRY_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS entryAt , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(AT.EXIT_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS exitAt , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd , CS.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS completionStatusNm , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 세션 개설사(내 회사와 다르면 타사 세션 — 서비스가 사업장명을 비우고 개최 회사 라벨로 대체한다, plan D3). */ , S.CMPNY_CD AS hostCmpnyCd FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 세션 헤더 조인에서 CMPNY_CD 제거 → 자기 직원의 타사 세션 이수 이력 포함. 인가 전제: userAttendanceWhere 의 AT.CMPNY_CD = gvCmpnyCd(내 회사 출결행)가 인가 그 자체다. */ INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( S.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS053' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) CS ON ( AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = CS.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
ORDER BY IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, S.INSERT_DATE) DESC, AT.ATTENDANCE_CD DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectEvidenceSharedSessions */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , HST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , HC.CMPNY_NM AS hostCmpnyNm , S.TITLE AS title , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', S.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(S.STARTED_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(S.ENDED_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , IFNULL(S.EDU_MINUTES, 0) AS eduMinutes , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND AT.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL ) AS attendanceCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND AT.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completedCount , 'Y' AS sharedYn FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE HST ON ( S.CMPNY_CD = HST.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = HST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY HC ON ( HC.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD ) WHERE S.CMPNY_CD <> #{gvCmpnyCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(S.ENDED_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00')) >= #{fromDate} AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(S.ENDED_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00')) <= #{toDate} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT2 WHERE AT2.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND AT2.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND AT2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT2.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY S.ENDED_AT LIMIT 1000

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectEvidenceAttendees */ SELECT AT.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , CASE WHEN AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN RU.USER_NM ELSE DU.USER_NM END AS userNm , AT.USER_TYPE_CD AS userTypeCd , C.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(AT.ENTRY_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS entryAt , DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(AT.EXIT_AT, @@SESSION.time_zone, '+09:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS exitAt , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd , CASE WHEN AT.ENTRY_SIGN_FILE_MGMT_CD IS NOT NULL OR AT.EXIT_SIGN_FILE_MGMT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS signedYn FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( S.SESSION_CD = AT.SESSION_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER RU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = RU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = RU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER DU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'DAILY' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = DU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = DU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = AT.CMPNY_CD ) WHERE AT.SESSION_CD IN #{cd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND (S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} OR AT.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd}) ORDER BY AT.SESSION_CD, AT.ENTRY_AT, AT.ATTENDANCE_CD

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectEvidenceRisks */ SELECT SR.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , CASE WHEN RA.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN RA.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK SR INNER JOIN TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT RA ON ( SR.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND SR.SITE_CD = RA.SITE_CD AND SR.PROCESS_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND SR.ASSESSMENT_CD = RA.ASSESSMENT_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND RA.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD ) WHERE SR.SESSION_CD IN #{cd} ORDER BY SR.SESSION_CD, SR.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectEvidenceMtrls */ SELECT SC.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , M.TITLE AS mtrlTitle FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( M.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND M.MTRL_CD = SC.MTRL_CD ) WHERE SC.SESSION_CD IN #{cd} ORDER BY SC.SESSION_CD, SC.DISPLAY_ORDER
